_comment: Deterministic severity policy (domain/service/SeverityPolicy.kt, doc/DATA_SCHEMA.md 'Severity policy'). The LLM severity is only a hint: final = max(hint, floors). escalation_cues: with an URGENT mode (or injury) they make the severity Critical; matched on lowercase text with word boundaries and the negation guard of mode_keywords.json ("it's not urgent" does not count). high_incident_types: at least High on their own. escalation_cues is English; escalation_cues_other holds Hindi cues marked needs_native_review.
